_schema: docs/SYSTEM_TABLES.md §2 角色表 — the draw pool. Drawing an archetype fixes culture, faith, start city and the 2–3 cities that background would already have heard of.

note.zh: 路上好事、隐藏路线、恶劣天气减免、迷路概率
note.en: Fortune on the road, hidden ways, weather, and how often you lose it

note.zh: 与陌生文化、商人、宗教人士、官员对话的成功率
note.en: How strangers, merchants, clerics and officials receive you

note.zh: 贸易利润、讨价还价、被偷窃与货损概率

gradeNote.zh: 低等不是废号。「下下」更容易触发苦行、流亡、改宗、奇遇与隐士路线——那些路线有专属事件、导师与结局。命格决定你玩哪一种游戏，不决定你玩得好不好。
gradeNote.en: A low grade is not a bad roll. The lowest opens the ascetic, the exile, the convert, the hermit — roads with their own events, teachers and endings. Fate decides which game you play, not how well you play it.

obsession.zh: 跟着父亲和叔父东行，去看看大汗的宫廷是不是真的。
obsession.en: Follow your father and uncle east, and find out whether the Khan's court is real.

portrait.zh: 十七岁，从未出过海，但站在里亚尔托桥上能指着每一面帆说出它的去处。
portrait.en: Seventeen, never been to sea — but from the Rialto you can name every sail in the lagoon and say where she is bound.

name.en: A Traveler in Ibn Battuta's Manner

obsession.zh: 完成朝觐，并从不同方向一再回到麦加。
obsession.en: Complete the hajj — and return to Mecca from every direction.

portrait.zh: 二十一岁，法学生，行囊里是一本《穆瓦塔》和一封给沿途法官的介绍信。
portrait.en: Twenty-one, a student of law, carrying a Muwatta and a letter to every qadi on the road.

obsession.zh: 把父亲那条船的航路走完，走到没有人认得你的口音为止。
obsession.en: Finish your father's sailing-routes — and keep going until nobody knows your accent.

portrait.zh: 浪里生浪里长，学了一口能跟各国水手讨价的混杂话。天妃听得懂所有口音的祷告。
portrait.en: Raised on the swells, with a mongrel tongue for haggling with any sailor afloat. Mazu, you were taught, understands every accent.

obsession.zh: 去汗廷，把辩论做完——不是为了赢，是为了知道对面说了什么。
obsession.en: Reach the Khan's court and finish the debate — not to win it, but to hear what the other side actually says.

portrait.zh: 赤足行路，因为会规如此。行囊里是圣经、圣器和一份没人愿意翻译的国书。
portrait.en: Barefoot, because the Rule says so. In the pack: a bible, the vessels, and a royal letter nobody will translate honestly.

name.en: An Interpreter of the Treasure Fleet

obsession.zh: 把西洋各国的港口、货、王、风都记进海图。
obsession.en: Get every western port — its goods, its king, its winds — into the chart.

portrait.zh: 生在云南的穆斯林之家，学的是官话与阿拉伯语。你替一支比城池还大的船队说话。
portrait.en: Born to a Muslim family in Yunnan, schooled in the officials' tongue and in Arabic. You speak for a fleet larger than most towns.

obsession.zh: 没有执念。走到哪里算哪里，学会一路上所有人肯教的东西。
obsession.en: No obsession. Go where the road goes, and learn everything anyone is willing to teach.

portrait.zh: 父亲是景教徒，母亲是草原人。你在两边都算外人，也因此两边的门都虚掩着。
portrait.en: A Nestorian father, a steppe mother. A stranger on both sides — which is why both doors stand slightly ajar.
